name: AR_RECEIPT_CLASSES
description: The AR_RECEIPT_CLASSES table stores user-defined receipt classes. Receipt classes determine if receipts that are assigned to a receipt class are manually or automatically created and also indicate the required processing steps, such as confirmation, remittance, and clearance. . The primary key for this table is RECEIPT_CLASS_ID.

columns.name: RECEIPT_CLASS_ID
columns.description: Receipt class  identifier.

columns.name: CONFIRM_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether confirmation is required for this receipt

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: AUTOMATIC for automatic receipt creation, MANUAL for manual receipts

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CLEAR_FLAG
columns.description: N if no clearance required (receipt created as cleared), S by automatic clearing, Y by matching

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Receipt class name.

columns.name: REMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether remittance is required for this receipt

columns.name: CREATION_STATUS
columns.description: Receipt creation status

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REMIT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: FACTORING if receipts must be factored.  STANDARD for standard remittance. STANDARD_AND_FACTORING if both options available to user.
